newsitem.title: USA: GreenStone to be acquired by Louisiana-Pacific.
newsitem.headline: GreenStone to be acquired by Louisiana-Pacific.

text.p: GreenStone Industries Inc., a manufacturer of cellulose insulation and speciality fibers from recycled paper, said Tuesday it has agreed to be acquired by Louisiana-Pacific Corp. for about $36 million.

GreenStone, which had revenues of $41 million in 1995, said it signed a non-binding letter of intent to be acquired by the building product company and expects the transaction to close by the end of 1996.
Louisiana-Pacific had revenues of $2.8 billion last year.
Holders of publicly traded shares will receive $5.25 per share in cash. Management and certain non-public shareholders will receive non-registered securities of Louisiana-Pacific of equivalent value.
